title: Attention Is All You Need
audience: ML and GenAI developers learning attention
objective: Inspect how a positional signal changes one query token's attention scores, weights, and output.
question: How does changing position affect the tokens this query attends to?
claim: Scaled dot-product attention computes compatibility scores, normalizes them with softmax, and uses the weights to combine value vectors.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of adding positional information to token representations?

options.text: To provide information about token order
To increase the number of attention heads

quiz.explanation: The paper adds positional encodings so the model can make use of sequence order.

limitations: Vectors are fixed teaching inputs, not learned embeddings.
This simplified experiment applies a positional signal directly to query and key vectors; it is not the full Transformer implementation.
The experiment illustrates the attention equation; it does not reproduce the trained model or paper benchmark results.
